data.exact_reserve_text: Prior period reserve releases amounted to GBP 103.7 million (2013: GBP 29.8 million) due primarily to improvements within aviation, marine, financial lines, property and inwards reinsurance lines. There was also a significant prior year reserve release relating to the World Trade Centre losses of September 2001.
specific_events: World Trade Centre losses of September 2001

prior_year_events.impact_description: significant prior year reserve release relating to the World Trade Centre losses of September 2001, contributing to overall improvements within aviation, marine, financial lines, property and inwards reinsurance lines.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2488 reported a significant prior period reserve release of GBP 103.7 million in 2014, representing 9.4% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was primarily driven by improvements across several lines of business, including aviation, marine, financial lines, property, and inwards reinsurance. A notable component of this release was attributed to the World Trade Centre losses of September 2001. The release was distributed across direct insurance lines such as Fire and other damage to property (GBP 15.8m), Marine, aviation and transport (GBP 57.2m), Accident and health (GBP 0.6m), Third party liability (GBP 23.0m), and Miscellaneous (GBP 0.5m), as well as Reinsurance acceptances (GBP 6.6m).

data.data_quality_notes: For LOB movements, 'Marine, aviation and transport' is treated as both Marine and Aviation. 'Reinsurance acceptances' is mapped to 'Treaty'. 'Fire and other damage to property' is mapped to 'Property'. 'Third party liability' is mapped to 'Casualty'. 'Miscellaneous' is mapped to 'Other'.
